'''AG-15''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Larek]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[AG-16]], AG-15, and a number of additional droids were sent out to locate ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] security droids and extract their memory cores, but the droids were destroyed before they could do so.
